Listed as an NPHC chapter on greek.arizona.edu/council/nphc, but greek.arizona.edu/cultural-affiliation/african-american lists Alpha Phi Alpha under NPHC marked 'inactive'. Status could not be reconciled between UArizona's own pages.

universities.research_notes: IFC list is from greek.arizona.edu/council/ifc, where all 9 chapters are individually marked 'Active Chapter: On'. NPHC/USFC data is inconsistent across UArizona's own pages: greek.arizona.edu/council/nphc lists only Alpha Kappa Alpha and Alpha Phi Alpha as NPHC members (no status shown), while greek.arizona.edu/cultural-affiliation/african-american lists 6 additional historically-Black organizations (labeled 'USFC' on that page, though nationally these are NPHC orgs) and shows Alpha Phi Alpha and an Alpha Kappa Alpha entry with an 'inactive' signal — a direct contradiction with the NPHC council page, flagged above. Panhellenic (stated as '13 unique chapters') and the remainder of USFC's non-NPHC multicultural roster were not itemized by name on the pages retrieved in this pass (the USFC 'Meet the Chapters' subpage was not reachable), so they are omitted rather than guessed.

universities.name: Arizona State University
universities.research_notes: All chapters sourced from eoss.asu.edu/fsl/governing-councils-and-groups/governing-councils (ASU's own Educational Outreach & Student Services site), which lists 5 councils: IFC, MGC, NALFO, NPHC, and Panhellenic (PHA/CPH, not itemized here). NALFO chapters were mapped to council 'Other' since NALFO is not one of this schema's 5 standard categories. A separate, non-asu.edu site (sites.google.com/asuifc.org) claiming to be 'IFC of ASU' listed a different, larger IFC roster (32 chapters, including Acacia, Chi Phi, Delta Chi, Kappa Sigma, Omega Delta Phi, Phi Mu Alpha Sinfonia, Sigma Alpha Epsilon, Sigma Phi Epsilon, Tau Epsilon Phi, and Triangle, none of which appear on the official eoss.asu.edu list) — since it isn't on the university's own domain it was not used as a primary source, but the conflict is noted rather than silently resolved. Panhellenic chapters (13, per eoss.asu.edu) were not itemized here.

universities.research_notes: USC's official IFC page (greeklife.usc.edu/interfraternity-council/) lists only 6 currently-recognized chapters, notably smaller than older rosters — several historically-USC fraternities (older search snippets mention Alpha Gamma Omega, Chi Phi, Delta Chi, Delta Tau Delta, Kappa Alpha Order, Lambda Chi Alpha, Phi Delta Theta, Phi Kappa Tau) are no longer university-recognized/affiliated per USC's own note that 'a number of former USC fraternities have chosen to disassociate.' universities.name: University of Nevada, Las Vegas

chapters.review_reason: unlv.edu/sia/fraternity-sorority (main FSL page) lists 'Alpha Phi Alpha Fraternity, Inc' as an active chapter under the LVFA/IFC section, while UNLV's own dedicated NPHC page lists it as the NPHC chapter (Sigma Psi Chapter). Nationally Alpha Phi Alpha is an NPHC organization, so it is classified as NPHC here, but the conflicting council label on UNLV's own main page is unresolved.
Listed as an active MGC sorority on UNLV's dedicated MGC page, but does not appear at all in the MGC roster on UNLV's main fraternity-sorority page.

Listed as an active MGC sorority on UNLV's dedicated MGC page, but listed under 'Inactive Chapters' in the MGC section of UNLV's main fraternity-sorority page — a direct contradiction between UNLV's own two pages.

UNLV's main fraternity-sorority page lists Gamma Zeta Alpha under 'Inactive Chapters' for MGC, while UNLV's dedicated MGC page lists it as a 'Raza Unida Colony' (i.e., forming/re-forming) — the two official UNLV pages characterize its status differently.

universities.research_notes: Primary source unlv.edu/sia/fraternity-sorority itemizes chapters with unusually granular official status labels (Active / Emerging / Closed / Inactive for the Las Vegas Fraternity Association i.e. IFC; Active / Emerging for NPHC; Active / Emerging / Inactive for MGC) and was used as the base; 'Emerging' chapters were mapped to status 'unknown' since 'emerging' isn't one of this schema's 5 statuses, and 'Closed' IFC chapters were mapped to 'inactive'. Cross-checked against UNLV's own dedicated NPHC and MGC subpages, which disagree with the main page in several places (Alpha Phi Gamma, Sigma Theta Psi, Gamma Zeta Alpha) — flagged needs_review. UNLV's own IFC/LVFA active list oddly includes 'Alpha Phi Alpha Fraternity, Inc,' which both nationally and per UNLV's own NPHC page (Sigma Psi Chapter) is an NPHC organization; it is classified here as NPHC only, with the discrepancy noted rather than double-listed under both councils.
